body.name: cross-fitted doubly robust frontier estimator
body.construction: Choose foldwise learners attaining \(r_{m,n}\) and \(r_{e,n}\), clip the outcome learner to \([-B,B]\), clip the propensity learner below at \(\epsilon/2\), construct \(\widehat v_i\), \(\widehat W\), and \(\widehat K\) as declared, and set \(\widehat\theta_c\in\arg\max_{\theta\in\Theta}\{\widehat W(\theta)-c\widehat K(\theta)\}\) and \(\widehat\tau(c)=(\widehat\theta_c,\widehat W(\widehat\theta_c),\widehat K(\widehat\theta_c))\).
